name: @kanzo-tech/navigation
description: Kanzo's unsaved-changes guard — one useBlocker in TanStack Router's shape over the Navigation API and beforeunload, and a /next door for the App Router's Link and router. Sibling of @kanzo-tech/ui, not part of it: a router integration is product territory by /docs/philosophy, and nothing here draws.
//peers: react is REQUIRED: the root is a hook. next is optional and lives behind `./next`, from 15.3 because that is the release `Link` gained `onNavigate` — the only cancellable moment Next gives a link — and through 16, the major this package builds and tests against. A host that is not Next installs this package alone and gets the browser half. Deliberately absent: tailwind-variants and @kanzo-tech/ui, because nothing here draws; the confirm dialog is the product's AlertDialog. That absence is also what keeps this package out of the appearance guards, whose corpus in packages/ui/src/guard-corpus.ts selects on that dependency.
//gauges: One gauge per published entry, and one per tree-shaken import a consumer meets; `scripts/gauges.mjs` (through `.size-limit.mjs`) is what each measures, and every limit's reason — each raise, dated, with its before and after — is a row on /docs/design, *A gauge per entry, and its raises written here*.
